days.name: Posture & Pull Focus
days.focus: Upper Body Pull / Posterior Chain / Posture Correction

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Squeeze shoulder blades at top; control the negative.

exercises.name: Face Pulls (Cable)
exercises.notes: Externally rotate at end range; focus on rear delts and mid traps.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)
exercises.notes: Initiate by depressing scapulae before bending elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Upright torso; use squat to reinforce thoracic extension.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Press lower back into floor; slow and controlled.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.notes: Tall posture, shoulders packed; reinforces scapular stability.

days.name: Lower Body & Push-Pull Balance
days.focus: Lower Body Strength / Balanced Push-Pull / Metabolic Finish

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Hinge at hips; slight knee bend; feel stretch in hamstrings.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Retract and depress scapulae; don't let shoulders round forward.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.notes: Pull to lower chest; squeeze at peak contraction.

exercises.name: Walking Dumbbell Lunges
exercises.notes: Upright torso; controlled steps.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Aparts
exercises.notes: Light band; focus on scapular retraction.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swings (Metabolic Finisher)
exercises.notes: Powerful hip drive; rest 45s between sets.

days.name: Full Body & Posterior Chain
days.focus: Full Body / Posterior Chain Emphasis / Posture & Fat Loss

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.notes: Brace core; drive through mid-foot; stand tall at lockout.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: 30-degree incline; keep shoulders back and down.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Stable torso; pull elbow past ribcage.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pulls with External Rotation
exercises.notes: High cable; pull to forehead, rotate palms up at end.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat to Box
exercises.notes: Touch box lightly; stand up tall; reinforces upright posture.

exercises.name: Plank with Shoulder Tap
exercises.notes: Minimize hip rotation; engage glutes and abs.

exercises.name: Assault Bike Intervals (Metabolic Finisher)
exercises.notes: All-out effort for 20s, easy pedal 40s; repeat 5x.

progression.progressionRule: Increase load or reps by +10% after 2 pain-free sessions.
conditions: No shoulder or back pain during or after workouts
All sets completed with good form
RPE does not exceed 8 on compound lifts

safetyNotes: Always warm up with 5-10 minutes of light cardio and dynamic stretching before lifting.
Prioritize form over load, especially on hinge and squat patterns.
If you feel sharp pain (not muscle fatigue), stop the exercise immediately.
Maintain a neutral spine during all lifts; avoid excessive rounding of the upper back.
For rounded shoulders: focus on pulling exercises that retract and depress the scapulae.
Stay hydrated and ensure adequate protein intake to support recovery and fat loss.
Consult a healthcare professional before starting any new exercise program if you have underlying health conditions.
warnings: This plan is for educational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice.
Listen to your body; modify or skip exercises that cause discomfort.
Progress gradually to avoid overuse injuries, especially with increased training volume.
Stop immediately if pain increases during an exercise.
Do not continue if dizziness, lightheadedness, or chest pressure appears.
Educational fitness recommendations only. Not medical advice.
